thread:
jordan.support: 08:12 UTC - multiple customers in eu2 reporting 502s + auth failures on hosted inference API. Tickets spiking, some customers see timeouts then 502s. Any network visibility?
incidents-bot: Incident created — INC-2026-3483. Paging #eng-sre and #net.
lee.sre: looking. grabbing api-gateway metrics and tcpdump from the eu2 edge LBs.
mike.net: pulling traceroutes from edge, seeing retransmits and packet loss at the provider hop. posting traceroute snippet.
```
traceroute to api.eu2.redwood.example (10.1.2.3), 30 hops max
 1  internal-lb (10.10.0.1)  0.4 ms
 2  edge-eu2-1 (10.20.0.1) 0.9 ms
 3  isp-peering-1 (203.0.113.5)  3.1 ms  1/10 pkt lost
 4  isp-core (198.51.100.17)  8.9 ms  7/10 pkt lost
 5  transit (203.0.113.9)  9.1 ms  0/10 pkt lost
```
lee.sre: packet loss concentrated between hops 3-4, matches the 08:10-08:18 502 spike window in metrics. Any BGP withdraws?
mike.net: no withdraws or AS path changes, AS paths stable. Provider acknowledged microbursts on 203.0.113.0/24 and opened ticket TKT-9982 with their backbone team.
sara.ops: if provider fix ETA is unknown we should steer traffic off eu2. Proposal: shift 90% of hosted inference traffic to eu1, keep 10% to eu2 for canary and to avoid churn. Also spin up extra capacity in eu1 for model pools.
lee.sre: agree. I'll update SmartRouter weights and change routing policy. Preparing rollout: 90/10 for eu1/eu2, healthchecks for model endpoints enabled.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift executed — eu1 weight 90%, eu2 weight 10% at 08:28 UTC. Health checks are reporting >95% success for eu1.
amy-cs: I'll send customer updates: "We've detected transient packet loss affecting our eu2 network provider. We've shifted routing to eu1 and are monitoring. We'll update when the provider confirms resolution."
jordan.support: added customer note to tickets and posted status in support portal.
mike.net: provider update: suspected flapping on a core link, they've isolated the aggregate and are testing repairs. We still observe occasional auth validations hitting timeouts during retransmit windows — that appears as 401s turning into 502s at the gateway.
lee.sre: mitigation in place, monitoring. I'll create follow-up action items: (1) add cross-az KV cache fallback to reduce auth calls to eu2, (2) increase circuit diversity for eu2, (3) require provider post-mortem & SLA review.
jordan.support: thanks all — last update 08:45 UTC. Leaving channel open until provider confirms full restore.
